trap.label: falso cognato
trap.wrong: Water is scary in the desert.
trap.right: Water is scarce in the desert.
trap.why: Scarce (escasso) lembra scare/scary (medo), e o brasileiro confunde a grafia e o sentido.

fix.right: Fresh fruit is scarce in winter.

rewrite.answer: Water is scarce in the desert.
